name: Beauty and the Cheat
overview: An Ivy League graduate and his college girlfriend embark on a daring crime spree in affluent downtown Philadelphia. Armed with their good looks and charm they dupe unsuspecting victims all to live a life of luxury and riches. Their lavish exploits, targeting friends, neighbors, colleagues, and strangers, come crashing down after one critical mistake leads police to their door, unveiling a sensational criminal lifestyle. Dubbed the modern-day "Bonnie and Clyde," their audacious escapades become a media sensation and leave the posh community questioning if they too were unsuspecting victims.
